label: u/w/o/d/v input at original positions 2-5
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase at positions t=2..5 (98% of mass), peaking at t=3, and never at t=0-1, t>=8, or in the copy phase. Within that window it fires on a fixed set of input tokens: u (strongest, 33% of mass, largest activations), w, o, d, v, plus weaker e. Activations are larger on the first occurrence of the token (in_first). The predicate (positions 2-5 and input in {u,w,o,d,v}) gets dev P=0.74 R=0.66 F1=0.70 and mass recall 0.83. What it misses is low-magnitude firing on other tokens (e, m, n, 2) in the same window and a small <DEL> response when L=3-4. False positives are mostly later positions (t=5) and repeated tokens. Top activations are u at t=3, often after j or b as the first token.
